p.src: 1  Out of the depths I have cried to you, LORD.

en: Out of the depths I have cried to you, LORD.
u.src: 1  Out of the depths I have cried to you, LORD.

en: 130:1 LORD or GOD in all caps is from the Hebrew יהוה Yahweh except when otherwise noted as being from the short form יה Yah.

p.src: 2  Lord, hear my voice. Let your ears be attentive to the voice of my petitions.

en: Lord, hear my voice. Let your ears be attentive to the voice of my petitions.
u.src: 2  Lord, hear my voice. Let your ears be attentive to the voice of my petitions.

p.src: 3  If you, LORD, kept a record of sins, Lord, who could stand?

en: If you, LORD, kept a record of sins, Lord, who could stand?
u.src: 3  If you, LORD, kept a record of sins, Lord, who could stand?

p.src: 4  But there is forgiveness with you, therefore you are feared.

en: But there is forgiveness with you, therefore you are feared.
u.src: 4  But there is forgiveness with you, therefore you are feared.

p.src: 5  I wait for the LORD. My soul waits. I hope in his word.

en: I wait for the LORD. My soul waits. I hope in his word.
u.src: 5  I wait for the LORD. My soul waits. I hope in his word.

p.src: 6  My soul longs for the Lord more than watchmen long for the morning, more than watchmen for the morning.

en: My soul longs for the Lord more than watchmen long for the morning, more than watchmen for the morning.
u.src: 6  My soul longs for the Lord more than watchmen long for the morning, more than watchmen for the morning.

p.src: 7  Israel, hope in the LORD, for there is loving kindness with the LORD. Abundant redemption is with him.

en: Israel, hope in the LORD, for there is loving kindness with the LORD. Abundant redemption is with him.
u.src: 7  Israel, hope in the LORD, for there is loving kindness with the LORD. Abundant redemption is with him.

p.src: 8  He will redeem Israel from all their sins.

en: He will redeem Israel from all their sins.
u.src: 8  He will redeem Israel from all their sins.
